dct_description_sm:
This Dataset includes all components needed to replicate the analysis in the article titled "Temporarily closing roads to motorized vehicles may benefit some sensitive bird species in a peri-urban park" by Gaston et al. (2026).

1. README: contains general project metadata and overview of the structure of this Dataset

2. RDMP: research data management plan for acoustic ARU data used in this manuscript (originally collected for M.V. Gaston's MSc thesis)

3. Data: includes processed data files, including species detection csv files from manually transcribing acoustic data and from using BirdNET

4. Analysis: contains all R scripts and data frames used for analysis

5. Article: related article
dct_title_s: Replication data for: Temporarily closing roads to motorized vehicles may benefit some sensitive bird species in a peri-urban park
